channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Experimental Zika vaccine shows T cells can protect without antibodies
item.description: Zika has circulated for decades but drew global attention in 2016 during an outbreak in the Americas. New research suggests a vaccine may work through T cells alone.

item.title: People say they wouldn't test embryos for traits like low IQ, but act on such data if given it
item.description: A survey of over 2,000 people in the U.S. and China shows that while many oppose embryo testing for non-medical traits, they would use the information if available.

item.title: Better maternity care linked to fewer stillbirths and newborn deaths in sub-Saharan Africa
item.description: Training, quality improvement, and leadership support in hospitals across four sub-Saharan countries are associated with reduced stillbirths and newborn deaths.

item.title: Gray-Market Retatrutide: Less Weight Loss, More CV Effects
item.description: Use of gray-market retatrutide is rising, but unapproved versions are not meeting expectations. Eli Lilly is urging increased oversight.
